records.summary: Fernando Mendoza named Raiders starting QB after being first overall pick; says it's a new step but not a whirlwind.
records.source_excerpt: Everyone knew that it was only a matter of time before Fernando Mendoza became the Raiders' starting quarterback, but the first overall pick in this year's draft said on Wednesday that he was taken by surprise when he learned the time had come.
